title: The stochastic Zakharov system in dimension $d \geq 4$: Local well-posedness and regularization by noise for scattering
summary: In this paper, we develop the well-posedness theory and uncover the noise-regularization effect on scattering for the stochastic Zakharov system in dimensions $d \geq 4$ and beyond the energy space. Our focus is particularly directed at the large data regime, where the global existence and long-time dynamics of the deterministic Zakharov system remain largely open.
